old_en: I cooked dinner myself.
new_en: I cooked dinner myself.

old_en: She moved into a new place all by herself.
new_en: She moved by herself.

old_en: The child dressed himself up nicely.
new_en: The child dressed himself.

old_en: We figured out the solution ourselves.
new_en: We solved the problem ourselves.

zh: 这件事你们自己决定吧。
old_en: You decide this matter yourselves.
new_en: You guys decide for yourselves.

old_en: They resolved the issue by themselves.
new_en: They fixed the problem themselves.

zh: 没有人帮忙，他们自己修好了水管。
old_en: Without help, they fixed the pipe themselves.
new_en: Without help, they fixed the pipe themselves.

old_en: The cat opened the door all by itself.
new_en: The cat opened the door by itself.

old_en: The little cat jumped onto the table by itself.
new_en: The kitten jumped onto the table by itself.

zh: 这件事我自己去就行了。
old_en: I'll handle it myself.
new_en: I'll take care of it myself.

old_en: I myself made three dishes and one soup.
new_en: I made three dishes and one soup myself.

old_en: You yourself must be careful on the road.
new_en: Be careful on the road yourself.

zh: 一个人出门，你自己多注意。
old_en: You yourself should pay more attention when going out.
new_en: When going out alone, pay more attention yourself.

old_en: He fixed the computer himself.
new_en: He fixed the computer by himself.

zh: 她没请人帮忙，自己搬了家。
old_en: She moved house herself without asking anyone for help.
new_en: She moved without help from anyone.

zh: 这件事我们自己来处理。
old_en: We will handle this matter ourselves.
new_en: We will handle this ourselves.

zh: 去哪里玩，你们自己商量。
old_en: You yourselves decide where to play.
new_en: You decide where to play.

old_en: You don't need to accompany me, myself going there.
new_en: You don't need to come with me, I'll go alone.

zh: 电脑坏了，他自己动手修好了。
old_en: The computer broke, so he fixed it himself.
new_en: The computer broke, so he fixed it by himself.

zh: 孩子已经会自己穿鞋了。
old_en: The child can already put on his shoes himself.
new_en: The child can put on shoes by himself now.
